 **<The Greysteel Company>**

Hello everyone! I am pleased to announce officially on the forums that, <The Greysteel Company> is recruiting and actively seeking out new members!

Do you Role Play? Are you searching for a community of like-minded individuals to RP with? Is your character in need of work? Or, on the other side, does your character have work to give? The Greysteel Company is open to any type of character. One can ICly join the company, or they can be a contract/ally of the guild.

You do NOT have to be a "adventurer" kind of character. The premise of the guild is that we will take any and all jobs that come our way. Even it it's as simple as - collecting ingredients for some kind of *ahem* stew. Or taking a book all the way to Menethil Harbor! Of course there will always be your, rescue the damsel, kill the enemy kind of jobs.

That's where you come in! We have dedicated officers who are more than willing to build story content for the guild and progress - but the most fun we've had is when others bring forth their own ideas and events to the guild.

The best part about it is, because we're a work for contract premise - we have just about good reason to be anywhere in Azeroth! We even turned a suicide run through Orgrimmar just to run Ragefire Chasm into a IC mission to rescue an elf from deep within the bowels of the Horde City. That person then decided to join the guild to keep the RP going!

We encourage new and old RPers alike. We're a very friendly and welcoming guild. Conflicts are few and far between, and members are encouraged to bring up any concerns or questions to the officers/leadership of the guild.

Our most active time is during the weekends, usually around 10am PST. We have members in the guild from all over the world, a healthy European population as well as American. We try to have an official RP event at least once a week. The goal is to get RP flowing pretty consistently and having members RP during down time between guild events!

Ashlynn and Blackmoore co-lead the guild. With Talvik being second in command. You can message them in game for any questions/comments/concerns.

 **Discord names:**
@Caelinmarie#3616  @Spades#6557 @Kuba15100#2960

Any member that is above entry level can send a guild invite.

![Image](https://i.ibb.co/CV2NcTP/Assembly-of-Gnomeregan-Seal-Solid-1.png)
 *image credit to A.I.D.O.S <https://moon-guard.fandom.com/wiki/AIDOS>*

 *Calling all Gnomes! Following the defeat of our people in Gnomeregan and the loss of our capital city, the **<Gnomish Federation>** has been established as a centralized government for the Gnomish people. We will strive to bring all Gnomes together in our fight to reclaim our capital city. Join today!*

 **Guild info**
The **<Gnomish Federation>** is a casual RP/PvE guild who's directive is to secure and advance the interests of the Gnomes. Members are not required to RP, but it is highly encouraged. We seek to be compatible with RPers, hardcore raiders, and even PvPers. Our main focus is to be a tight-knit group of dedicated players that make the server a more enjoyable place.

Given our lore, all members must be Gnome, with some exceptions for certain members down the road.

A huge Thank You  to all supporters of the Federation who have so far reached out to offer support in any way

 **Our mission**
We are focused on two goals: the reclamation of our capital city Gnomeregan, and the peace and security of Azeroth. Our standing with the Alliance is of the utmost importance to the Federation, and we are as equally determined to further its cause as we are our own.

 **Structure**
- **King of Gnomes** - Geblin Mekkatorque
Following the invasion of Gnomeregan by the Troggs, **High Tinker** Geblin Mekkatorque was persuaded to release toxic radiation throughout the capital city in order to eradicate the Troggs. This backfired and caused the loss of Gnome life in great numbers and forced Gnomes to abandon Gnomeregan.

The King of Gnomes now resides in Tinker Town, in Ironforge, dictating the Gnomes as they seek to take back their homeland.

- **Governor** - Oddzag Wirefizz
An engineer by trade, Oddzag Wirefizz was appointed to the governorship of the Federation by **High Tinker** Mekkatorque at its founding shortly after the Gnomes established Tinker Town. Oddzag has long been a member of reconnaissance organizations within Gnomish society.

- **Founder**
A largely sentimental title, Founders are original signers of the Federation's charter, who signed with authority on behalf of their race to lend legitimacy to the Federation's cause. They serve as representatives to the Federation from their race's governments and are forever praised for their belief in the cause of Gnomish security.

- Executive:
All matters of Federation business, from citizen affairs, interdepartmental matters, leadership tasks, etc are carried out by Federation Executives. Hand chosen by the Governor and the Department Heads, they serve in both the back and front of house, conducting high-level assignments that involve all levels of the Federation and Azeroth's affairs.

 *For more guild information, check out the wiki page <https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Gnomish_Federation>*

 **Federation Departments**

All Gnomes within the Federation are sorted into their respective department based on his or her specialty. To view a member's title within that department, check their public note. Department titles are chosen by each member, as they know the best role they're suited for.

- **Department of State**:
Responsible for the foreign policy and relations of the Gnomish people, the Dept of State handles all interactions with leaders of the Alliance, as well as with neutral factions and even the Horde.

- **Department of Defense**:
The Federation Department of Defense is tasked with the security of the Gnomish people. Entrusted with maintaining the Gnomish military, they also work hand-in-hand with the Dept of Intel.

- **Department of Intel**:
All Gnomish intelligence and covert operations are executed by the Department of Intel. While strictly confidential, the Dept of Intel has established itself amongst the Alliance as competent and highly valuable in the war against the Horde.

- **Department of Engineering**:
Most technical aspects of Gnomish society are maintained by the Department of Engineering; transport, architecture, civil engineering, etc. Engineering is a revered aspect of Gnomish society and as such, the department is well regarded.

- **More internal structuring to come**

 *To join our ranks, please PST Oddzag or Slimothy in-game.*

 **This thread is a WIP, please excuse the incompleteness.**

Maybe my English is really bad, but I'll try to tell my vision of the paladin. Many say that this is vanilla + and there is no need to use talents and skills of other add-ons, including Wotlk. However, Blizzard showed in SoD that it is possible to change the paladin's ret for the better.
 1. CD for CS and HS should be different, and it would be good to make an exorcism instead of HS, which will work on everyone (like in SoD).
 2. Following the example of SoD, you can make CS regenerate mana and not spend mana when using it, you could add mana regeneration like in Wotlk when using justice.
 3. It is necessary to return protection from the dispel of the seal in talents, or even get away from the system of using the seal once every 30 seconds and make, for example, the seal as a buff for 5-10 minutes. (Wotlk).
 4. Add at least some mobility to the class. For example, like in cataclysm, when using justice, the running speed increased by 3 seconds.
Now the paladin is a disabled class. The seal system was a mistake, it was introduced by Blizzard right before the start of vanilla. So if we have vanilla+ on the turtle, maybe we will make a paladin DD, and not something else.
There will simply be a paladin who will use justice, CS, exorcism and consecration. And not constant pressing on the seal, which can be dispelled and 2 hits with a common cooldown.
